channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: Exchange deposit memos need a clear path across chains
item.description: An exchange memo can route a deposit to the right account, but a bridge may not carry it across chains; check the final network, address and tag before sending.

item.title: How to move gaming proceeds into another game's tokens
item.description: Gaming proceeds can fund another game, but only after you match the token, network and fees; this guide explains the swap path and the checks to make first.

item.title: Recheck the Swap Quote After a Wallet Session Expires
item.description: If a wallet session expires during a swap, reconnecting does not confirm the old quote is still usable; check the amount, route and fees again before signing.

item.title: How to turn crypto into a restaking position
item.description: A restaking position starts with an asset the protocol accepts, then adds a service and operator choice; check conversion costs, exit terms and added risk.

item.title: Five steps to fund an Ethereum validator
item.description: A validator deposit starts with 32 ETH, prepared keys and a synced node; these five steps cover the Launchpad, wallet transfer and what happens next.

item.title: Compare Cross-Chain Routes by What Arrives
item.description: Compare cross-chain routes by the amount that should arrive, the time estimate, and the fees each route takes, then check the destination token before sending.

item.title: Ledger says hidden chips sent CryptoBilis wallet phrases over LTE
item.description: Ledger says hidden hardware in some CryptoBilis-sold wallets copied 24-word recovery phrases during setup and sent them over LTE, putting buyers’ crypto at risk.

item.title: Why a BTC-to-ETH swap can return less ETH
item.description: A BTC-to-ETH swap can return less ETH than its quote because pool depth, fees and price movement change the amount that arrives before the trade settles.

item.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow upgrade for Oct. 21
item.description: Solana will begin Alpenglow’s mainnet rollout on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system built to make transactions final in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Pick the token you need before you bridge
item.description: Choose the destination token before bridging: a route that delivers the asset you need can spare a second swap, extra fees and avoidable price risk on arrival.

item.title: Manta Bridge deposits: what if you use the wrong network?
item.description: A wrong-network deposit may not be recoverable. The transaction details show what happened, what to check next and how to avoid repeating the mistake.

item.title: Blockchain.com Seeks US Approval for Event Markets and Derivatives
item.description: Blockchain.com filed for two CFTC registrations to offer US event contracts and crypto derivatives, a move that could bring both products onto its platform.

item.title: How to Use super bridge From Your Own Wallet
item.description: A wallet-to-wallet bridge moves crypto between chains, but the source network, destination, fees and final confirmation all matter before you send funds.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as liquidations hit $771 million
item.description: Bitcoin fell 2.8% to $81,382 on Monday as $771 million in crypto positions were forcibly closed in 24 hours, most of them bets on rising prices.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, with $1 million each for six, after the Senate blocked a major crypto market bill.

item.title: Pham Says CFTC Law Already Reaches Most Crypto Markets
item.description: Former CFTC acting chair Caroline Pham says existing US law gives the agency wide reach over crypto, as it weighs rules for leveraged retail trades.

item.title: Sui’s Hashi to launch with more than $500M committed
item.description: Sui says Hashi will start a phased mainnet rollout this month with more than $500 million committed, as Anchorage adds institutional access and liquidity.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for crypto election spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate leaves its crypto market bill stalled.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, with $1 million each for six, as the crypto market bill remains stalled in the Senate before November's midterms.

item.title: Cardano Foundation spins Veridian out with shares onchain
item.description: Cardano Foundation has made Veridian an independent Swiss company and put most of its one million shares on Cardano, giving CIP-0113 its first equity use.
